title: Alignment Services & Plans Cancellation, Refund and Tire Bundle Schedule
content:
The cancellation window, the deduction per included alignment, the refund destination and the tire bundle discount of Alignment Services & Plans are set per line in this schedule.

| Line | Cancellation window, calendar days after the purchase date | Deduction per included alignment already performed, purchase-day alignment included (USD) | Refund after the window | Where a refund goes | Tire bundle discount (USD) | Tire bundle window, calendar days after the tire set's install date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment | 0 (not cancellable) | 0.00 | no refund | the tender that paid for the holding | 0.00 | 30 |
| Crestline Four-Wheel Alignment | 0 (not cancellable) | 0.00 | no refund | the tender that paid for the holding | 0.00 | 30 |
| Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan | 30 | 109.99 | no refund | the tender that paid for the plan | 20.00 | 30 |
| Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | 30 | 109.99 | no refund | the tender that paid for the plan | 30.00 | 30 |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | 30 | 109.99 | no refund | the tender that paid for the plan | 40.00 | 30 |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | 30 | 129.99 | no refund | the tender that paid for the plan | 40.00 | 30 |

### Definitions used in the schedule

- **Cancellation window.** The number of calendar days after the purchase date within which a plan may be cancelled for a refund; a window of 0 means the holding is not cancellable.
- **Deduction per included alignment.** The amount deducted from a cancellation refund for each included alignment already performed on the plan, the purchase-day alignment included.
- **Tire bundle discount.** The discount on the plan price when the plan is bought within the tire bundle window of a Crestline tire set installed on the same vehicle; the window counts calendar days after the tire set's install date.

### Worked reading (hypothetical)

A Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan bought with a Crestline tire set installed on the same vehicle 12 days earlier falls inside the 30-day tire bundle window of its line. A tire set installed 31 days before the purchase falls outside the window.
